values.note: Pull-in sites not designed for RVs; three of the seven are longer than 21 ft and may take an RV.

sites.source: FS page ('No. of Sites 7'; 'Sites are pull-in and not specifically designed for RVs. Three of the seven sites are longer than 21 feet and may accommodate an RV.'), read 2026-11-11

values.note: No garbage pickup; pack out all garbage, including fish remains.

facilities.source: FS page ('Vault toilet(s)'; 'Potable water is not available at this site. No potable water available – lake water must be treated.'; 'There is no garbage pick up at Toohey Lake Rustic Campground.'), read 2026-11-11

season.source: FS page ('Seasons of Use May 8 - October 1'; 'The road is not plowed during the winter.'), read 2026-11-11

booking.source: recreation.gov search for 'Toohey' finds no facility; README rule (AWH 2026-10-22): a federal campground with no recreation.gov listing is first-come only. FS page names no booking channel. Read 2026-11-11

fees.source: FS page ('Fee Site and Info: No fees are required for this site. There is no fee at rustic campgrounds.'), read 2026-11-11

note: Superior NF rustic campground on Toohey Lake, right off FR 170 (The Grade) west of the Sawbill Trail, with a boat launch, dock and trailer parking. Only three of the seven sites take an RV, so a 23-ft rig may find them full. --Claude
